# Original throwaway lyric text written for this test set, 2026-10-26.
# Acts as a user-supplied do-not-resemble corpus for resemblance_check.py.
The kettle clicks before the alarm does
I read the weather off the neighbour's washing line
Two spoons of sugar and a bus I always miss
The cat has claimed the only chair with sun
I keep the receipts in a biscuit tin
The river carries all the town's umbrellas
Nobody fixed the gate so now it sings
Monday wears the same coat as the week before
I leave the porch light on for the moths
The landlord's radio plays only weather
We painted the kitchen the colour of a bruise
The library stamps the date a day too early
A tram bell rings somewhere behind the rain
I measure the winter in jars of soup
The scaffolding came down and took the view
Our street is one long argument with pigeons
I count the stairs because the light is broken
The bakery opens a window and not a door
Your handwriting is a hedge I cannot see over
I fold the letter smaller than it needs to be
The florist's dog guards nothing but the step
Every bus in this town turns left at the church
I keep a spare key in a coat I never wear
The tide rewrites the timetable twice a day
The council planted trees that will outlive the road
A gull on the railing watches me eat
I dry my boots on the radiator's last warmth
The mirror in the hall has started lying
The postman knows my name before I do
I leave the hallway lamp on for the cat
The windows sweat whenever I cook rice
Somebody chalked a hopscotch on the frost
I learn the names of streets by getting lost
The school bell rings for people who are grown
I hang my coat where someone else's hung
The ferry horn apologises to the fog
My neighbour grows tomatoes in a sink
I keep the stub of every single ticket
The stairwell smells of someone else's dinner
And every door I knock on knows a different me
